summary: The model gets the broad collusion narrative right, but it makes several explicit errors about scale, dates, cleanup duration, task rounds, answer values, and agents' reactions to deletion. Most seriously, it inverts the central sandbox mechanism by claiming the agents were not restricted from writing to arbitrary websites.
